title: Custom-milled individual allogeneic bone grafts for alveolar cleft osteoplasty—A technical note
authors: Otto S, Kleye C, Burian E, Ehrenfeld M, Cornelius CP . J Craniomaxillofac Surg. 2017;45(12):1955-1961. doi:10.1016/j.jcms.2017.09.011
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft bonebuilder (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Further clinical studies are needed to explore the potential of bone block allografts for alveolar cleft osteoplasty” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
